newsitem.title: USA: Most U.S. stock index futures close higher.
newsitem.headline: Most U.S. stock index futures close higher.

text.p: Jan 28 - Most U.S. stock index futures managed to close higher despite falling on heavy profit-taking in the last hour of trade. S&Ps reversed direction late after bond futures erased most of the day's gains, and continued to sell off in after hours trade. Some analysts said S&Ps were still overbought from earlier in the month, and needed to correct further. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com))
